name: cav-accessibility-scanner
description: Bundled accessibility scanner (Playwright + axe-core) used by the Cavisson Jenkins plugin's Accessibility Scanner task. Copied functionally from the Cav Accessibility Scanner Azure DevOps extension's task/scanner directory - scan.js/generate-report.js and the report/ renderer are environment-agnostic (driven only by the REPORTS_DIR env var) and are reused verbatim.
